description: This file defines the PortfolioAccountDTO class, a Data Transfer Object used to represent portfolio account data in the Apache Fineract project. It includes various constructors, getter methods, and a setter for the groupId field.

classes.name: PortfolioAccountDTO
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object class for portfolio account data, encapsulating account type, client ID, currency, status, deposit type, and overdraft exclusion flag.

methods.name: PortfolioAccountDTO
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields with provided values.

methods.name: PortfolioAccountDTO
methods.description: Overloaded constructor initializing with accountTypeId, clientId, and accountStatus, setting other fields to defaults.

methods.name: PortfolioAccountDTO
methods.description: Overloaded constructor initializing with accountTypeId, clientId, currencyCode, accountStatus, and depositType; other fields set to defaults.

methods.name: getAccountStatus
methods.description: Returns the array of account status IDs.

methods.name: getFirstAccountStatus
methods.description: Returns the first account status ID from the array.

methods.name: isExcludeOverDraftAccounts
methods.description: Indicates whether overdraft accounts are excluded.
